source.title: Inverse problems for stochastic partial differential equations: Some progresses and open problems

trace.notes: Input normalized as zbMATH Open document 7868838. The zbMATH API record identified DOI 10.3934/naco.2023014 and the title "Inverse problems for stochastic partial differential equations: Some progresses and open problems"; zbMATH was used only as a resolver, not as the technical source.

The DOI resolved to the AIMS article page with the same exact title. The AIMS page exposed the PDF URL https://www.aimsciences.org/data/article/export-pdf?id=642564796565307f274c7469, but the PDF check returned a login requirement, the no-login page stated that full-text access was restricted, and the export-pdf endpoint produced an empty artifact rather than a readable PDF.

Bounded exact-work recovery used the DOI, exact title plus PDF, exact title plus authors, and the AIMS PDF filename. OpenAlex pointed back to the same unusable AIMS PDF endpoint. ResearchGate matched the same DOI and title but reported that no full text was available. Remaining candidates were metadata pages, snippets, request-full-text pages, or different works.

No questions were extracted because no readable exact-work PDF or full HTML source exposing the technical open-problem statements was recovered. The accessible pages were resolver metadata, abstract/landing content, references, or restricted access pages, which are inadequate technical sources under the source adequacy gate.
Saved final JSON to outputs/parse-paper/7868838.json and outputs/latest.json.
